कंट्रोल प्लेन CLI — AI एजेंटों के लिए --json प्राथमिकता दें।
दस्तावेज़: docs/agent/README.md · docs/cli/reference.md · docs/agent/commands.json
help.main:
{{product}} ({{cli}}) v{{version}}

कंट्रोल प्लेन CLI — AI एजेंटों के लिए --json प्राथमिकता दें।
दस्तावेज़: docs/agent/README.md · docs/cli/reference.md · docs/agent/commands.json

उपयोग:
  {{cli}} <command> [options]

कमांड:
  setup                 dataDir + admin आरंभ करें
  update                स्व-अपडेट जाँच/लागू करें
  serve                 HTTP API + Web UI
  system unit-install   ysk-server.service स्थापित करें [--enable]
  tools                 टूल सूची; tools run --tool <name> [--dry-run]
  ask                   NL → AI योजना [--execute]
  projects              list|get|create|deploy|stop|health|backup|template
  backup                all|list|status|restore|delete|schedule|control-plane|settings|restic
  templates             ऐप टेम्प्लेट
  hosting               nginx|dns|db|firewall सहायक
  dns                   zone|zones (AI उपनाम → hosting dns-*)
  logs                  sources|query|journal|overview
  host                  overview|metrics (केवल पढ़ना)
  nginx                 status|list|test|sync
  ssl                   list|get (प्रमाणपत्र)
  db-cluster            list|get|create|plan (HA पहले-योजना)
  ssh-key               list|create|import|public|export|install|delete (SSH पहचान वॉल्ट)
  ssh-2fa               list|enroll|confirm|install|pam|retire (SSH लॉगिन TOTP ≠ पैनल 2FA)
  services              होस्ट सेवा मैट्रिक्स (systemctl जाँच)
  defense | protection  status|ban|unban|whitelist
  security              status|sessions|api-keys (2FA फ़्लैग · सत्र रद्द · API कुंजियाँ)
  cdn                   nodes|sites|render|apply|purge|probe|dashboard|health-loop|from-project
  agents                runtimes|fleet list|commands|register (पैनल + edge)
  agent run             आउटबाउंड फ्लीट पोलर (प्रयोगात्मक)
  store                 status|export|import|migrate (json|sqlite|postgres दस्तावेज़ बैकएंड)
  files                 list|read|write|mkdir|rm|stat|rename|copy|move|chmod|trash|shares (सैंडबॉक्स)
  cron                  list|create|delete|enable|disable|run|install|status
  email                 domains|mailboxes|deliverability|bootstrap|dns (पैनल समानता)
  health                स्थानीय मोड स्नैपशॉट या --url http://host:port/health
  readiness | doctor    प्रोडक्शन तत्परता (ईमानदार)
  migrate               inventory|host|post|status|resume (पूर्ण होस्ट माइग्रेट)
  version | help

वैश्विक:
  --json                JSON stdout (AI)
  --data-dir PATH
  --config PATH
  --help | --version

एग्ज़िट: 0 ठीक · 1 त्रुटि · 2 सत्यापन · 3 अवरुद्ध · 4 नहीं मिला · 5 होस्ट त्रुटि

सुरक्षा:
  खतरनाक संचालन डिफ़ॉल्ट dry-run (केवल योजना)।
  होस्ट बदलने के लिए --execute (उपनाम --apply) + env YSK_EXECUTE=1 दें।

उदाहरण:
  {{cli}} readiness --json
  {{cli}} host --json
  {{cli}} nginx status --json
  {{cli}} ssl list --json
  {{cli}} projects get --id UUID --json
  {{cli}} defense ban --ip 1.2.3.4 --json          # dry-run योजना
  {{cli}} projects list --json
  {{cli}} logs query --source journal: --lines 100 --json
  {{cli}} tools --json

vnc.pageDesc: Remote desktop: multi Linux-user VNC sessions, noVNC in the browser, and outbound client profiles.
vnc.executeOn: YSK_EXECUTE is on — install, useradd, and sessions can apply when root.
vnc.executeOff: YSK_EXECUTE is off — status is live, but install / Linux users / sessions stay blocked until enabled.
vnc.accountsEmptyDesc: Use Create account to add a Linux user and VNC session.
vnc.clientPathHint: Connect via the server (noVNC proxy) or via your own network (vncviewer / direct RFB).
vnc.clientEmptyDesc: Import a remote host:port in a later PR. Choose via-server or direct path when connecting.
vnc.installHint: Install TigerVNC first, then noVNC for browser access. XFCE is optional (larger download).
vnc.needTigerVnc: TigerVNC server is required for multi-user sessions
vnc.needNovnc: noVNC + websockify for browser remote desktop
vnc.needViewer: Optional TigerVNC viewer (this host as client, direct path)
vnc.needViewerOrNovnc: Viewer or noVNC recommended for client tab
vnc.settingsHint: Defaults apply to new accounts. Changing RFB bind to “all interfaces” exposes ports — prefer localhost + noVNC or VPN.
vnc.autostartLabel: Start VNC session on boot (when applied)
vnc.accountListDesc: Each account is a separate Linux user and TigerVNC display.
vnc.createAccountDesc: Creates a dedicated Linux user (yskvnc_*) and VNC session settings.
vnc.passwordHint: Optional on create; min. 6 characters. Written with vncpasswd when root+EXECUTE.
vnc.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
vnc.startAfterCreate: Start session after create (needs root + YSK_EXECUTE)
vnc.deleteAccountDesc: Remove control-plane account {{name}} ({{user}}). Session will be stopped first.
vnc.deleteAccountC3User: Linux user home will be removed (userdel -r)
vnc.deleteAccountC3Keep: Linux user will be kept on the system
vnc.removeLinuxUser: Also remove Linux user and home directory
vnc.connectionPathsHint: Prefer via server (noVNC on localhost). Direct RFB needs bind=all + firewall.
vnc.directLocalhostWarn: RFB is localhost-only — change bind to all interfaces for direct internet clients, or use SSH tunnel / noVNC.
